summary.text: Denise Smith, a Conservative Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Assembly District 80 to John Zaccaro Jr.

She ran for New York City Council District 11 on that line in 2025. Little biographical information about her is publicly documented; no campaign website has been identified, and she has not completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey.

paragraphs.text: Smith won the Conservative Party primary for New York City Council District 11 in 2025, and in the November 2025 general election she received 4.0% of the vote (1,462 votes) on the Conservative Party line, behind incumbent Eric Dinowitz (D) and Stylo A. Sapaskis (R).

For 2026 she advanced from the June Conservative Party primary for Assembly District 80 without appearing on the ballot, after the primary was canceled; Ballotpedia lists her as having withdrawn from the Republican primary.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Smith lost to John Zaccaro Jr., according to unofficial results from the NYC Board of Elections and Wikipedia.
